title: AI指南与报告资源合集仓库
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了关于人工智能、机器学习、智能体AI、AI Agents、深度学习和大语言模型等主题的报告与指南列表，为AI领域学习者和从业者提供参考资料索引。
summary_en: A GitHub repository curating a list of reports and guides on AI, machine learning, agentic AI, AI agents, deep learning, and LLMs, serving as a reference index for AI learners and practitioners.
